title: Brandon Fugal: Skinwalker Ranch phenomenon is reflective

tellings.quote: Uh Brandon Fugal uses it when he goes to Skinwalker Ranch. He says clearly >> the phenomena is reflective.

plain: Whatever strange thing happens at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of unexplained events, "is reflective," meaning it mirrors back the people who come to it, according to a man named Brandon Fugal who goes there. The researcher Grant Cameron passes this on to Michels as Fugal's view, which, if right, would mean the phenomenon responds to its observers.
